verdict.rationale: Anytime Mailbox documents forwarding packages domestically or internationally, redirecting parcels on request, and scheduling a day and time for pickup, so the hold/pickup/forward core is covered. The evidence never states which carriers the address accepts packages from, and never mentions consolidating multiple packages into one shipment. missing for 10: explicit acceptance of packages from all major carriers (UPS/FedEx/DHL/Amazon), package consolidation, explicit package hold policy/duration, independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a digital nomad, the address accepts packages from all major carriers and can consolidate or hold them for pickup or forwarding

citations.quote: Forward letters and packages anywhere, domestically or internationally.
forward mail or a package to a different address
Redirect postal mail and parcels to a secure forwarding address and manage them remotely from a phone app or web portal.
You can also schedule a day and time for pickup.
